scope_statement: These checks verify the local harness and the request behaviour of the unmodified official client against a local mock CDN. They are NOT evidence of any Storyblok product operation; every protocol operation remains blocked in operations.jsonl.

checks.title: Ports and client endpoint are consistent before the run
checks.observable_result: port 4322 in use before start: false; port 4399 in use before start: false; client endpoint http://127.0.0.1:4399/v2 points at the mock CDN: true
checks.notes: poc-plan.md §8.3 allocates 4321 to candidate 1 and 4322/4323 to candidate 2. A concurrent EmDash POC held 4321 during this run, which is why this harness moved to dedicated ports and asserts its own process identity (H4).

checks.title: TypeScript/astro check passes on the harness
checks.observable_result: astro check exited 0 with the checker's "0 errors" summary line: true

checks.title: Official guide config (output: "server", no adapter) — actual build result
checks.observable_result: The documented config failed the build with exit 1 and an adapter-related message.

observed_values.first_error_line: [NoAdapterInstalled] Cannot use server-rendered pages without an adapter. Please install and configure the appropriate server adapter for your final deployment.

checks.title: On-demand build succeeds with the official @astrojs/node adapter
Served HTML renders the story content fetched through the official client
checks.observable_result: GET / returned 200 from the harness's own process: true; 3/3 expected POC Test strings present in the served HTML

matched: Published text for the shared feature block.

checks.title: version=draft and version=published return different bodies from the same route
checks.observable_result: /?version=draft contained the draft-only marker: true; the published route contained the published-only text: true

checks.title: One registered component definition renders in two different content items
checks.observable_result: the shared feature headline appeared on both / (true) and /poc-test-second-page (true)

checks.title: Nested blocks (grid with repeated teaser children) render through StoryblokComponent
checks.observable_result: 3/3 nested-block markers present in the served HTML

checks.title: Modelled SEO fields from the content item reach the served <head>
checks.observable_result: 4/4 expected head tags present with the exact invented values

checks.title: Site emits the documented frame-ancestors CSP on the on-demand route (our side only)
checks.observable_result: Content-Security-Policy response header from the harness's own process was: "frame-ancestors https://app.storyblok.com"
checks.notes: This verifies only that our site can emit the header the Visual Editor requires. Whether app.storyblok.com will accept the iframe, and the vendor's HTTPS-for-localhost requirement, are untested (no account).

checks.title: Official client sent the expected CDN requests (token present, version parameter)
checks.observable_result: mock CDN served 8 requests to the official client (versions seen: draft, published), every one carrying the token parameter; 1 unauthenticated request(s) were rejected with 401 by the mock's own token check
checks.notes: The CDN base URL was redirected to 127.0.0.1 by the harness endpoint override; the request shape (path, query parameters) is generated by the unmodified official client.

checks.title: Static (build-time fetch) output also renders the same content
checks.observable_result: static build exit 0; dist/index.html present: true; published text rendered at build time: true
checks.notes: Static output emits files, so response-header behaviour (H9) and per-request draft reads do not exist in that mode; the draft path requires the on-demand build.

checks.title: No credential value appears anywhere in the evidence tree
checks.observable_result: no evidence file contains the invented placeholder token value; no real credential was ever configured
commands: scan evidence tree for the placeholder token value

checks.title: Screenshots of the rendered harness pages (local harness UI, not the vendor app)
checks.observable_result: 2 headless Chromium screenshots captured at 1280x900 (home-published.png=24187B, home-draft.png=24169B)
checks.notes: These are pixels of the local harness page. No Storyblok UI exists or was reachable in this run, so no vendor screenshot can be produced.

checks.title: Client-side script the integration injects into the public page (recorded, not judged)
checks.observable_result: the public page references 1 module script(s): /_astro/page.CZkWFe1x.js (2271 B)
commands: read dist/index.html and stat the referenced assets
checks.notes: Recorded because AGENTS.md treats client JavaScript as a design constraint. The Storyblok Astro integration injects its bridge loader by default; this measurement covers one page of the harness only.
